answer: Each PoA task is created after commitment from a domain-separated hash of that commitment and the next drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse; karst, forge, and zephyr serve as domain labels. The pulse is unknowable until threshold release, so a swarm cannot precompute valid answers or reuse offline-farmed work. Responses bind to the fresh challenge and are verified against the beacon proof. This blocks advance preparation, while stake or rate limits remain necessary to cap Sybil identities.
